projects.name: curlz
projects.tagline: A keyboard-driven HTTP client that lives in your terminal.
projects.summary: Build, send and save API requests from a TUI instead of a browser tab — the Postman loop without the context switch.
highlights: Compose requests with method, headers and body from the keyboard
Save requests and replay them on demand
REST and HTTP work without leaving the shell

projects.name: zod-refiners
projects.tagline: Composable Zod refiners you copy into your own project.
projects.summary: A set of isolated, single-purpose refiner functions for Zod. No runtime dependency, no indirection — the code becomes yours the moment you paste it in.
highlights: Each refiner is standalone and independently testable
Copy-in distribution keeps you off a version treadmill
Documented examples for the common validation cases

projects.name: sitta-chat
projects.tagline: A chat platform built ticket by ticket by an agent crew.
projects.summary: A full chat application where the whole build was driven by AI agents working a ticket queue — architecture, API and UI shipped incrementally, with every decision traceable to a ticket.
highlights: Ticket-driven delivery: one scoped change per closed ticket
Server and client contracts kept in sync through typed schemas
Built as the proving ground for the agent workflow in warsha

projects.name: warsha
projects.tagline: A crew of AI agents that builds and ships its own tools.
projects.summary: The workshop: a multi-agent setup with defined roles, a shared ticket board and a review gate, used to take real projects from brief to merged code.
highlights: Role-separated agents with explicit ownership boundaries
Shared ticket board as the single source of truth
Review and verification gates before anything ships

projects.name: tanstack-quote-generator
projects.tagline: TanStack Start front end talking to a tiny Express API.
projects.summary: A small end-to-end experiment: typed TanStack Start routes on one side, a minimal Express service returning random quotes on the other.
highlights: Route-level data loading with typed results
Separate API process to keep the client honest about async states
Small enough to read in one sitting

projects.name: siyar-search
projects.tagline: Search Siyar A'lam al-Nubala by wording or by meaning.
projects.summary: A search layer over a large classical Arabic biographical corpus: give it a phrase or a concept and it returns the volume and page where the passage sits.
highlights: Exact-wording and meaning-based lookup over the same corpus
Every result resolves to a volume and page reference
Interface built for long research sessions, not one-off lookups

projects.name: college
projects.tagline: Lecture notes, flashcards and quizzes generated from course material.
projects.summary: A study system that turns university course material into notes, flashcards, quizzes and summaries, packaged as a reusable skill rather than a one-off script.
highlights: Same source material produces notes, cards, quizzes and summaries
Packaged as a reusable skill, not a throwaway script
Built around how revision actually happens, not how syllabi are written
